Pages marked with <syntaxhighlight lang="handlebars" inline>{{Wiki|delete}}</syntaxhighlight> are listed here.

Make sure that said article has no more links towards it (including redirections) before submitting it for deletion.
Try to include a deletion reason (e.g <syntaxhighlight lang="handlebars" inline>{{Wiki|delete|duplicate page}}</syntaxhighlight>) whenever possible.
